title: しごと — Work
summary: A work reading for JLPT N4 practice.
summary_en: A work reading for JLPT N4 practice.
summary_id: A work reading for JLPT N4 practice.

paragraphs.text: 毎日運動することにした。
paragraphs.translation: I decided to exercise every day.
paragraphs.translation_en: I decided to exercise every day.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya memutuskan untuk berolahraga setiap hari.

paragraphs.text: 雨が降りそうです。
paragraphs.translation: It looks like it will rain.
paragraphs.translation_en: It looks like it will rain.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sepertinya akan turun hujan.

paragraphs.text: 明日、荷物を持っていきます。
paragraphs.translation: I will take the luggage with me tomorrow.
paragraphs.translation_en: I will take the luggage with me tomorrow.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya akan membawa barang bawaan saya besok.

paragraphs.text: 雨が降ってきた。
paragraphs.translation: It started to rain.
paragraphs.translation_en: It started to rain.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hujan mulai turun.

paragraphs.text: 新しいレストランで食べてみる。
paragraphs.translation: I will try eating at the new restaurant.
paragraphs.translation_en: I will try eating at the new restaurant.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya akan mencoba makan di restoran baru.

paragraphs.text: この本は高いに違いない。
paragraphs.translation: This book must be expensive.
paragraphs.translation_en: This book must be expensive.
paragraphs.translation_id: Buku ini pasti mahal.

title: りょこう — Travel
summary: A travel reading for JLPT N4 practice.
summary_en: A travel reading for JLPT N4 practice.
summary_id: A travel reading for JLPT N4 practice.

paragraphs.text: 朝ご飯を食べずに出かけた。
paragraphs.translation: I went out without eating breakfast.
paragraphs.translation_en: I went out without eating breakfast.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya keluar tanpa sarapan.

paragraphs.text: 今度の週末は何もするつもりはない。
paragraphs.translation: I don't plan to do anything this weekend.
paragraphs.translation_en: I don't plan to do anything this weekend.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya tidak berencana melakukan apa pun akhir pekan ini.

paragraphs.text: 明日の朝のために水を出しておく。
paragraphs.translation: I will put out water for tomorrow morning.
paragraphs.translation_en: I will put out water for tomorrow morning.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya akan mengeluarkan air untuk besok pagi.

paragraphs.text: 友達が傘を貸してくれた。
paragraphs.translation: My friend lent me an umbrella.
paragraphs.translation_en: My friend lent me an umbrella.
paragraphs.translation_id: Temanku meminjamiku payung.

paragraphs.text: 田中さんに日本語を教えてもらう。
paragraphs.translation: I receive Japanese lessons from Tanaka.
paragraphs.translation_en: I receive Japanese lessons from Tanaka.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya menerima pelajaran bahasa Jepang dari Tanaka.

paragraphs.text: この料理はおいしいに決まっている。
paragraphs.translation: This dish is definitely delicious.
paragraphs.translation_en: This dish is definitely delicious.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hidangan ini pasti enak.

title: まち — The City
summary: A city reading for JLPT N4 practice.
summary_en: A city reading for JLPT N4 practice.
summary_id: A city reading for JLPT N4 practice.

paragraphs.text: 明日から禁煙することにします。
paragraphs.translation: I will decide to quit smoking from tomorrow.
paragraphs.translation_en: I will decide to quit smoking from tomorrow.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya akan memutuskan untuk berhenti merokok mulai besok.

paragraphs.text: 来年、日本に留学するつもりだ。
paragraphs.translation: I intend to study abroad in Japan next year.
paragraphs.translation_en: I intend to study abroad in Japan next year.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya berniat untuk belajar di luar negeri di Jepang tahun depan.

paragraphs.text: これからも頑張っていく。
paragraphs.translation: I will keep doing my best from now on.
paragraphs.translation_en: I will keep doing my best from now on.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya akan terus melakukan yang terbaik mulai sekarang.

paragraphs.text: 先生が漢字を教えてくれた。
paragraphs.translation: The teacher taught me kanji.
paragraphs.translation_en: The teacher taught me kanji.
paragraphs.translation_id: Guru mengajari saya kanji.

paragraphs.text: この靴を履いてみてもいいですか。
paragraphs.translation: May I try on these shoes?
paragraphs.translation_en: May I try on these shoes?
paragraphs.translation_id: Bolehkah saya mencoba sepatu ini?

paragraphs.text: あの人が合格するに決まっている。
paragraphs.translation: That person will definitely pass.
paragraphs.translation_en: That person will definitely pass.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang itu pasti lolos.

title: けんこう — Health
summary: A health reading for JLPT N4 practice.
summary_en: A health reading for JLPT N4 practice.
summary_id: A health reading for JLPT N4 practice.

paragraphs.text: 何も言わずに帰った。
paragraphs.translation: I went home without saying anything.
paragraphs.translation_en: I went home without saying anything.
paragraphs.translation_id: Aku pulang ke rumah tanpa berkata apa-apa.

paragraphs.text: 友達に本を貸してあげた。
paragraphs.translation: I lent a book to my friend.
paragraphs.translation_en: I lent a book to my friend.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya meminjamkan sebuah buku kepada teman saya.

paragraphs.text: ドアを開けておいてください。
paragraphs.translation: Please leave the door open.
paragraphs.translation_en: Please leave the door open.
paragraphs.translation_id: Silakan biarkan pintunya terbuka.

paragraphs.text: 財布を落としてしまった。
paragraphs.translation: I dropped my wallet (by accident).
paragraphs.translation_en: I dropped my wallet (by accident).
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya menjatuhkan dompet saya (secara tidak sengaja).

paragraphs.text: 父に車を貸してもらった。
paragraphs.translation: My father lent me his car.
paragraphs.translation_en: My father lent me his car.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ayah saya meminjamkan mobilnya kepada saya.

paragraphs.text: 彼女は猫みたいだ。
paragraphs.translation: She is like a cat.
paragraphs.translation_en: She is like a cat.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia seperti kucing.
